Instead of getting his act together, my father never tried to get involved with me again until recently when my mom died and he accepted custody. I got pissed and told my dad not to expect me to be around in a year when I turn eighteen, and his girlfriend told me I should be ashamed for using that as blackmail. 5. **Resourcefulness and Problem-Solving:** Navigating the many logistical challenges of family life encourages creative problem-solving and adaptability. You become skilled at making the most of limited time, energy, and resources.

6. **Sense of Purpose and Meaning:** Many parents find that these responsibilities give their lives a sense of purpose and meaning. The love and connection you build with your children can be deeply rewarding and grounding.
